newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech budget CZK 3.6 bln in deficit end-Aug - paper.
newsitem.headline: Czech budget CZK 3.6 bln in deficit end-Aug - paper.

text.p: PRAGUE, Sept 3 (Prague) - The Czech state budget showed a 3.6 billion crown deficit at the end of August, with expenditures at 312.3 billion for the first eight months of the year, the economic daily Hospodarske Noviny said on Tuesday.
Last week, the cabinet approved 9.3 billion in spending cuts after Finance Minister Ivan Kocarnik warned that the budget, planned to be balanced, could end the year with a deficit.
Kocarnik attributed the worsening balance to lower than expected tax revenues, delayed debt repayments from Russia and higher expenditures.
Finance Ministry officials were not immediately available for comment.
The Czech Republic has run three balanced budgets since Czechoslovakia split in 1993.
